_comment: Shared vectors for the crypto payment rules and for the invoice's Dismiss and countdown rules (mmm/ZCASH-CONTRACT.md §4.4.2). invoiceDismiss: drop = the saved invoice is gone; keep = an account invoice stays saved and comes back at the next resume; hide = an invoice bought without a sign-in (network or code) stays saved, hidden. sdk/crypto_pay_test.go and sdk/crypto_invoice_view_controller_test.go (Go) and js/test/crypto_pay.test.ts and js/test/crypto_invoice.test.ts (TypeScript) replay every vector here, so the two implementations cannot drift. Addresses are synthetic fixtures; the Solana recipient is the sdk's fixture key, never the merchant. Countdown times: quoted_at and expires_at are the server's clock, received_at the device's when the quote arrived. The coins of mmm/BTCPAY.md §17 (tao, btc, eth, sol) joined on 2026-11-10: cryptoAssets pins every coin's facts (ticker, label and its localization key, icon key, decimals, quote decimals, market, uri scheme, tab), cryptoPaymentQrText what an invoice's QR code encodes, cryptoPaymentTabLayout the payment widget's tabs and their coins in order, and cryptoPaymentTabs which tabs a surface shows and which of their coins are available (every other coin of a shown tab has its label greyed with Temporarily unavailable; no icon is ever dimmed). ltc stands for a coin this sdk does not know.
